column4: Winding path of round 3D nodes: done (gold check), current (bright, ringed), future (grey). Mascot sits beside the path.
Active node with a glow ring and a speech-tag label above it; one obvious next step.
Locked course shown as a greyed card with a single big JUMP HERE pill; illustration stays visible.
Progress rail with round lock nodes and a big full-width START pill on a warm coral field.
Character-packed splash: the whole cast on screen, chunky rounded wordmark.
Two characters as guides, a single huge arrow button, no text needed.
Stacked large pill answers, one coloured as selected; audio-first prompt.
Mascot listening with a music note: waiting state carried by the character.
Soft painted forest scene, pet in the centre, three round discovery nodes (flag, found cherry, ? still hidden).
Character finds items in the scene and talks through speech bubbles: hunt + narration in one.
Large square tiles in a 2-column grid, matched pairs fade, correct state in green.
Match the pairs: round letter-name buttons paired with notes on a staff; tap to hear, then match.
Four colourful note characters with faces as tappable sound objects, on warm cream paper.
Line-art page with a bottom row of large round paint dots; a dark round toast announces the new palette.
Grid of round soundscape icons with one-word labels; calm, low-stimulation.
Colourful flat geometric shape puzzle (Mobbin label); clear-edged pieces, a model for islet pieces.
Put 7 squirrels in the box: drag items into a drop zone; pattern for the shadow/silhouette game.
Starry night illustration behind a story list with a narrator credit and a big Pause pill.
